name: facebookresearch_sapiens/pretrain/mmpretrain/models/multimodal/flamingo/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_sapiens/pretrain/mmpret.extend_init_flamingo: extend a language model base with gated cross-attention layers for multimodal Flamingo adapter initialization
facebookresearch_sapiens/pretrain/mmpret.forward_condition_layers: run the forward pass to condition Flamingo decoder layers on media locations before calling parent forward
facebookresearch_sapiens/pretrain/mmpret.clear_conditioned_layers: clear all conditioned decoder layers by resetting vision embeddings, media locations, and attend previous state
facebookresearch_sapiens/pretrain/mmpret.is_conditioned_check: check whether all decoder layers in the Flamingo adapter are already conditioned for the current forward pass
facebookresearch_sapiens/pretrain/mmpret.set_decoder_layers_attr_name: set the decoder layers attribute name path for recursive access to the language model decoder layers

facebookresearch_sapiens/pretrain/mmpret.build_flamingo_model: build a Flamingo multimodal model with vision encoder, language encoder, and tokenizer configs
facebookresearch_sapiens/pretrain/mmpret.predict_image_caption: predict image captions using the Flamingo model with zero-shot or few-shot inference
facebookresearch_sapiens/pretrain/mmpret.extract_vision_features: extract vision features from input images using the Flamingo vision encoder and perceiver resampler
facebookresearch_sapiens/pretrain/mmpret.preprocess_text_prompts: preprocess text prompts for zero-shot or few-shot inference by formatting and tokenizing them
facebookresearch_sapiens/pretrain/mmpret.post_process_outputs: post process generated outputs to extract captions or VQA answers from Flamingo model predictions

facebookresearch_sapiens/pretrain/mmpret.build_perceiver_resampler: build a PerceiverResampler to compress image features into learnable latent tokens with frame and media time embeddings
facebookresearch_sapiens/pretrain/mmpret.create_perceiver_attention: create a PerceiverAttention module that computes cross-attention between image features and latent tokens using multi-head attention
facebookresearch_sapiens/pretrain/mmpret.build_masked_cross_attention: build a MaskedCrossAttention layer that attends text features to visual media with optional temporal masking
facebookresearch_sapiens/pretrain/mmpret.create_gated_cross_attention_block: create a GatedCrossAttentionBlock combining masked cross-attention and feed-forward layers with learnable gating parameters
facebookresearch_sapiens/pretrain/mmpret.build_flamingo_layer: build a FlamingoLayer that conditions a decoder layer on visual features via gated cross-attention before language processing

facebookresearch_sapiens/pretrain/mmpret.build_ExtendModule: build a language model with an adapter by combining base module and adapter dict using ExtendModule
facebookresearch_sapiens/pretrain/mmpret.extend_instance_mixin: extend a base module instance with a mixin class to add new functions via ExtendModule.extend_instance
facebookresearch_sapiens/pretrain/mmpret.get_nested_attribute: get a nested attribute from an object using dot notation like a.b.c with getattr_recursive
facebookresearch_sapiens/pretrain/mmpret.set_nested_attribute: set a nested attribute on an object using dot notation like a.b.c with setattr_recursive
facebookresearch_sapiens/pretrain/mmpret.review_ExtendModule: review the ExtendModule class and its mixin pattern for combining language models with adapters
